name: The Engineering Firm
description: Each engineer at the firm leads a different project in a different discipline. Work out who's building what.
clues: Structural goes with at least one of Edison, Watt, or Bridge.
Rover goes with none of Tesla, Chemical, or Structural.
Watt, Structural, and Rover belong to different engineers.
